subject: Evaluation pack exchange & MAP runway: Lensify pilot
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Cole <dana@lensify.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Evaluation pack exchange & MAP runway: Lensify pilot

Hi Dana —

Thanks again for the productive call yesterday. As discussed, we'd like to get a short mutual action plan (MAP) in place so we can exchange the evaluation dataset, the prompt pack, and a small set of test-cases for the Lensify pilot. High-level proposal: 

- Redwood delivers: curated eval dataset (sample + full index), prompt pack (20 canonical prompts + edge cases), and an initial test-case harness.
- Lensify delivers: the S3 transfer details, a signed MPA/NDA, and a point of contact for ingestion issues.
- Acceptance gate: Redwood runs scoring on the shared prompt pack; we agree on an acceptance threshold (TBD) and smoke-test regressions.
- Takedown/retention: shared assets should be stored in sandbox and destroyed after 60 days unless both parties agree to extension. No redistribution outside this pilot; derivative model training prohibited.

I attached a draft MAP for your review (MAP-draft-Lensify-v1.pdf). Can you confirm if 60-day retention is acceptable to your legal/security team, and whether Lensify needs a different transfer mechanism than S3?

Next steps: if that timing works, we can schedule a 30-min handoff session this week and exchange the first sample set.

Best,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Partnerships — Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai

Attachment: MAP-draft-Lensify-v1.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Dana Cole <dana@lensify.io>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lensify Security <sec@lensify.io>
Date: Tue, 05 May 2026 10:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation pack exchange & MAP runway: Lensify pilot

Hi Sofia —

Thanks for the clear plan and the draft MAP. Quick notes from our side:

- Lensify security is generally comfortable with a 60–90 day sandbox window; 60 days is fine if we get a confirmed deletion + audit statement after takedown.
- We prefer to exchange the sample prompt pack via a pre-signed S3 link. For the full eval dataset we can accept a time-limited S3 grant or a secure rsync behind our transfer node — we can be flexible.
- Attached our standard non-disclosure appendix (LN-NDA.pdf) — we usually sign that in addition to partner MAPs.

Two small redlines to the MAP: 1) explicit prohibition on storing prompt->response pairs outside the sandbox (we require that for pilot data because of PII concerns); 2) a short list of allowed audit logs (request_id, timestamp, token-count only).

If you can accept those, we can sign and push the S3 access details.

Cheers,
Dana
Dana Cole
Head of Product Partnerships, Lensify
dana@lensify.io

Attachment: LN-NDA.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dana Cole <dana@lensify.io>
Date: Tue, 05 May 2026 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Evaluation pack exchange & MAP runway: Lensify pilot

Karthik / Kimberly —

Forwarding Dana's reply and the redlines they requested. Key asks from Lensify:

- 60-day sandbox retention with confirmed deletion + audit statement after takedown.
- No storage of prompt->response pairs outside sandbox; only minimal audit logs (request_id, timestamp, token-count).
- Transfer via pre-signed S3 links; full dataset transfer mechanism TBD.

Can you confirm whether the retention + audit approach meets our security policy and whether the minimal logs are sufficient for our acceptance testing? If we accept this we should update the MAP appendix and provide the eval-sample-list.csv (attached) for their initial ingest.

Proposed internal acceptance checklist (short):
- Confirm ingest worked and file checksums match.
- Run 20 canonical prompts from prompt pack and record top-level metrics.
- Confirm no PII leakage visible in smoke runs.

I'm happy to pull the MAP into a shared Drive doc if you prefer to iterate in-line.

Thanks,
Sofia

> On Tue, May 5, 2026 at 10:05 AM Dana Cole <dana@lensify.io> wrote:
> > Hi Sofia —
> > 
> > Thanks for the clear plan and the draft MAP...

Attachment: eval-sample-list.csv (text/csv)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 06 May 2026 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Evaluation pack exchange & MAP runway: Lensify pilot

Sofia / Kim / Marissa —

I'm comfortable with Lensify's redlines with two small edits from our side:

1) Retention window: agree to 60 days sandbox retention, provided Lensify issues a signed deletion + manifest within 7 days of takedown.
2) Logs: agree to minimal audit logs (request_id, timestamp, token_count). We will also retain a short internal ingestion log (file checksums, transfer timestamp) for our compliance team, but that log will not contain prompt/response content.

Operational notes: we should require Lensify to provide a HubSpot deal link for the pilot docs (I've added HS-23017) and include the transfer steps in the MAP appendix. Once they push the S3 manifest we can spin up the ingestion job.

Approved from security/compliance POV. Kim — please confirm from legal if we need any additional language in the MAP appendix.

Karthik
Principal, Applied ML Infrastructure — Redwood Inference

Related: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/81234
From: Dana Cole <dana@lensify.io>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lensify Security <sec@lensify.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 07 May 2026 14:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation pack exchange & MAP runway: Lensify pilot

Sofia / team —

Thanks — that all sounds good and reasonable. We will: 

- Sign the MAP with the 60-day retention and deletion manifest clause.
- Provide a time-limited pre-signed S3 manifest for the initial sample and a separate manifest for the full dataset when ready (see attached manifest stub).
- Confirm we will not store prompt->response pairs outside the sandbox and will restrict logs to request_id, timestamp, token_count.

I'll have Legal sign and send back the appendix today, and our infra lead will post the first pre-signed URL by EOD tomorrow.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — excited to get the pilot moving.

Best,
Dana
Head of Product Partnerships, Lensify

Attachment: lensify-s3-manifest.json (application/json)
